title: TypeScript provider request options for sourceAnalysis
description: The options member of the admitted canonical request, mirrored from the provider's own validation for the source-analysis operation.

sourceContract.drift: validateRequest is the authority and this document is its admitted mirror: a change to those lines requires a change here. Allowed keys are exactly OPTION_KEYS (:54, rejectUnknownKeys :158-162); the keys the C engine owns are refused by name for this engine (:55, :161-163); project defaults to the empty string when absent (:161); every read root is a nonempty string (:164-170); database admits the two DATABASE_ENGINES only (:74, :171-189) and carries path for sqlite-schema and connectionFile for postgres-schema; client carries a nonempty path with line and column defaulting to zero (:190-198); effects are a request member, not an option (:202-207).

operationBinding.detail: needsDatabase holds only when the selected projections include databaseAccesses on a position or symbol subject, and this operation serves the other projections, so database and client stay optional here and the sqlPlan document is the one that requires them

sourceContract.identityNote: no $id is set: the admitted identity is a hole for package admission to fill, named by the inventory it admits.

crossFieldRules.detail: the keys of options are exactly OPTION_KEYS; a C-only key refuses with context-option-unsupported-for-engine and any other refuses with context-option-unknown
requireU32 admits a safe integer from 0 to 0xffffffff, and nothing else
requireNonEmptyString admits a string of length at least one, and nothing else
